candidate_registry.rationale: Balance, loan, current-quarter income/expenses, and engine-calculated company value are five independent fixed-scale fields.
Counts use authoritative pools filtered to V1 company bus semantics and have explicit bounds/overflow.
Global summaries and separate per-tile ownership predicates preserve the distinction from any-road state.
Direct VehicleID slots include presence, location, age, capacity/load, profit, running state, and manual-order count.
Direct Town fields include typed rating presence and causal last-month supplied history.
Calendar year/day phase and bridge-owned action/tick budgets are known at the committed boundary.
The M03 fixture action is not the M05 policy registry; causal action-history encoding waits for the frozen action contract.
Reward components do not exist before M06 and cannot enter policy input without a later causal-history compatibility revision.
Height and clear-ground class come directly from TileHeight and TileType.
The frozen M02 contract forbids interior water and V1 bus actions cannot target water; an untested all-zero policy plane is rejected.
Any-road, company-owned-road, and four engine RoadBits planes remain separate.
The building predicate is exactly MP_HOUSE.
Two categorical attribution planes use stored house/road town IDs and Station::town; no nearest-town search is invoked.
Completed-house HouseSpec::population is normalized per tile.
The frozen no-NewGRF engine AddProducedCargo classification exposes causal generation potential without sampling production RNG.
The encoder reads Station::catchment_tiles through TileIsInCatchment and never recomputes it lazily.
Bus-stop presence and four GetBayRoadStopDir one-hot planes cover every diagonal orientation.
Depot presence and four GetRoadDepotDirection one-hot planes cover every diagonal orientation.
OpenTTD stores orders but not a stable future road path; invoking pathfinding in observation would violate non-perturbation.
Tiles for the first two valid manual station orders are the stable engine-backed spatial route representation.
Primary company road vehicles are counted by current Vehicle::tile with an eight-vehicle clip.
Static flat-clear feasibility and its valid-tile complement are causal cheap geometry features; M05 must combine them with command legality and masks.
MP_HOUSE has no generic OpenTTD tile owner and a categorical owner ID would conflate town/company/special owners; targeted road/infrastructure ownership is included instead.
Action selection state does not exist before the M05 action representation is frozen.
Candidate/action-specific connectivity belongs to M05; running pathfinding during M04 extraction is forbidden.
OpenTTD does not expose a native station profit ledger; invented attribution would not be authoritative.
OpenTTD cargo delivery is company-level and has no native causal per-route ledger.

route.deletion: slot presence becomes zero at the next committed boundary
route.id_reuse: a reused engine ID deliberately replaces the prior entity in the same slot; no stale features survive
route.overflow: omit routes whose VehicleID>=8 and set structured overflow.routes or overflow.vehicles
route.presence: local slot presence field; all other missing slot values are zero
route.slot_key: same slot as owning primary company road VehicleID

station.deletion: slot presence becomes zero at the next committed boundary
station.id_reuse: a reused engine ID deliberately replaces the prior entity in the same slot; no stale features survive
station.overflow: omit IDs>=16 and set structured overflow.stations
station.presence: local slot presence field; all other missing slot values are zero

town.deletion: slot presence becomes zero at the next committed boundary
town.id_reuse: a reused engine ID deliberately replaces the prior entity in the same slot; no stale features survive
town.overflow: omit IDs>=2 and set structured overflow.towns
town.presence: local slot presence field; all other missing slot values are zero

vehicle.deletion: slot presence becomes zero at the next committed boundary
vehicle.id_reuse: a reused engine ID deliberately replaces the prior entity in the same slot; no stale features survive
vehicle.overflow: omit IDs>=8 and set structured overflow.vehicles
vehicle.presence: local slot presence field; all other missing slot values are zero
